included: Current UK naval bases and air stations on the Royal Navy Bases and Stations directory
Major training and medical establishments on that directory
Active dockyards that Royal Navy or MOD sources explicitly identify as Royal Navy dockyards or integral naval-base dockyard facilities
Royal Marines bases on that directory as part of the Naval Service footprint
Separately commissioned support establishments with current Royal Navy evidence
Principal commissioned Royal Naval Reserve shore units with current official evidence
excluded: Sea Cadet units and ordinary recruiting offices
URNU and reserve satellite divisions that are not separately commissioned establishments
Joint or non-Royal-Navy facilities unless an officially named commissioned Royal Navy unit is present
caveats: HMS Gannet is excluded because the Royal Navy records its 2016 decommissioning, despite later articles using the name as geographic shorthand.

Rosyth Royal Dockyard is included despite commercial operation because current Royal Navy and MOD sources explicitly identify it as an active Royal Navy dockyard; ordinary commercial shipbuilders are excluded.
Devonport Royal Dockyard is shown separately from HMNB Devonport to distinguish the integral working dockyard from the wider naval-base entity.
HMS Drake, HMS Nelson and HMS Neptune are shown separately from their co-located naval bases because they remain the commissioned shore names for base personnel and support functions.
Representative coordinates are deliberately broad public locality points and must not be treated as entrances or operational positions.

coordinateDecisions.basis: The Royal Navy identifies HMS Excellent as located on Whale Island. This broad island-centre locality point was checked against the public basemap and deliberately avoids an entrance, named building, quay, marina, road junction or other operational infrastructure.
